text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened during summer camp—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan!
Do you have time tonight?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Actually, you see...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Mayano-☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Mave-chin!
Yaho-yahho~☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yaho-yahho & Marvelous☆
Ahaha, Mayano★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (She's Marvelous Sunday. If I recall, she's one of Mayano Top Gun's friends who debuted around the same time.)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to the festival together tonight~☆
I invited Nature too, so she's coming with us★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold your horses, runaway girl, wait a sec.
So far, I've only been "invited," right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the small stuff, don't sweat it~☆
So Mayano, what time should we meet up?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right!
About that, though...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I gotta pass this time! I really wanna do some secret training with Trainer-chan tonight!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Did we make a promise like that?
Did we make a promise like that?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I was just about to!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And so, Mave-chin, Nature-chan, go have fun at the festival!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-chan. Let's go♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oho~...? The sparkly girl seems to have quite the crush on her Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, helloooo?
Marvelous, you thereー?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaaarvelous!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, you really are super marvelous☆
You showed me a marvelous side that I never had★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nature! We gotta do it too!
Special training so we won't lose to Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Strike while the iron is marvelous☆
All right, here we gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
H-Huuuh~~!?
Whoa, whoa, stop pulling on meee--!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *sigh*~...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's 3 sets dooonne!
Trainer, what's next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whistleee...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm? Was that just now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Booooom... pitter-patter...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Fireworks!
Look, fireworks, Trainer-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's huge.
To think you could see it from a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I wonder how pretty it would have looked
in person at the venue?
choice_data_list: Did you really want to go to the festival after all?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. I'm all riiiight!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Because we can always go to a festival some other time."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
After I win at the Kikuka Sho
and squeeze Trainer-chan's heart tight, that is!
choice_data_list: You'll have to give it your all, then.
You'll have to give it your all, then.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
After I win at the Kikuka Sho
and squeeze Trainer-chan's heart tight, that is!
choice_data_list: You'll have to give it your all, then.
You'll have to give it your all, then.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, reeeally~?
I dunno about that~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely still not enough!
At least, that's what Maya thinks!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you so head over heels for me
that you won't be able to live without Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi, Trainer-chan,
you better be ready♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Mayano Top Gun
took off running down the beach once more.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. For Maya,
it's an absolute breeze♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm still growing! I'll be able to do it in no time at all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the Kikuka Sho and all kinds of other races,
and totally captivate my dear Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"When another summer with Trainer-chan comes around,
this time for sure, at the beach, I'll give a mature reward..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whistleee... KABOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat!? Why does it have to ring right *now*~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Stupid, stupid fireworks, you big jerks—!
Read the room a little better, will ya?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*BAAAANG!!*)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, the mood was so nice
just now~! Geez-!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hopping up and down repeatedly,
Mayano Top Gun kept yelling angrily at the fireworks...
